description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Memory' implements a decorator for caching definitions in memory, primarily used to improve performance or facilitate unit testing by storing cache entries in PHP's runtime memory.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Memory
classes.description: Decorator class that caches HTML purification definitions in memory to speed up retrieval and support unit testing scenarios.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Memory.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache associated with a specific configuration.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or replaces a definition in the cache for a specific configuration.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an existing definition in the cache for a specific configuration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached definition based on the provided configuration, using generateKey to identify cache entries.
